literal: With love joined way of life, they say, to the precious soul with bone joined connection.
translation: They say that the precious soul's connection to a body of bone is for the sake of living a life united with love.
modern: அருமையான உயிருக்கு எலும்பால் ஆகிய உடம்போடு பொருந்தியுள்ள உறவு, அன்போடு பொருந்தி வாழ்வதற்கான வழியே என்று கூறுவர்.
explanation: This couplet explains the fundamental purpose of human existence. The phrase 'ஆருயிர்க்கு என்போடு இயைந்த தொடர்பு' refers to the precious soul taking on a physical body, represented here by its framework of 'என்பு' (bone). The poet states that this union of body and soul is meant for 'அன்போடு இயைந்த வழக்கு', which means a life lived in harmony with love. Thus, the capacity to love is presented as the very reason a soul inhabits a physical form.
